name: OnDocumentModify
caption: When a record is created or modified (interactive)

configuration.description: Table to watch. Must be a supported table: Customer 18, Vendor 23, Item 27, Sales Header 36, Sales Line 37, Purchase Header 38, Purchase Line 39, Project 167, Project Task 1001, Project Budget Line (Job Planning Line) 1003, Contact 5050; Customer Subscription Contract 8052 and Customer Subscription Contract Line 8062 only where the Subscription Billing app is installed (BC26+). Extensions can register more tables. Known supported values: 18, 23, 27, 36, 37, 38, 39, 167, 1001, 1003, 5050, 8052, 8062. Extensions can register more, so other values are not rejected by this reference.
Run only in interactive client sessions. When true, writes from posting routines, Job Queue tasks or web-service calls without a UI do not start the flow.
Run while a new record is being inserted. There is no before-image: xRec_ outputs carry the field's blank value, and watch fields do not gate the insert (filters still apply).
Run while an existing record is being modified. Absent = true (older flows are modify-only).

Seconds the flow may run. Checked between steps: once it has passed, the remaining steps are skipped and the save goes ahead without the flow's answer. 0 or a negative value means no limit; the editor writes 30 instead.

Field filters on the record being saved (after-image): [{ "fieldNo": <integer>, "filter": "<BC filter expression>" }]. Applied literally with SetFilter (max 250 characters, no placeholders). A filter that Business Central cannot parse means the flow does not run. Two rows for the same field: the last one wins.

[{ "fieldNo": <integer>, "name": "<identifier>" }]. On a modify the flow fires only if at least one watched field differs between before- and after-image (no watch fields = every matching modify). Each entry produces outputs xRec_<name> and Rec_<name>. Duplicate fieldNo rows are ignored. The editor fills an empty name from the field caption in PascalCase and cuts it to 30 characters. Use a valid identifier (letter or '_' first, then letters, digits or '_') that is unique within the trigger.

outputs.name: Rec
outputs.when: always; tableNo = configuration.tableNo (declared as 'value' when tableNo is 0)

outputs.name: xRec_<watchFields[].name>
outputs.when: one per watch field; value before the change (on insert: the field's blank value), locale-invariant text (Format(value, 0, 9)); output name cut at 30 characters

outputs.name: Rec_<watchFields[].name>
outputs.when: one per watch field; value after the change, locale-invariant text (Format(value, 0, 9)); output name cut at 30 characters

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be > 0. Hard stop at publish.
rules.message: Pick the table the flow should watch.

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be a supported table (built-in list or registered by an extension). Hard stop at publish.
rules.message: Table %1 is not one of the supported tables.

rules.check: At least one of triggerOnInsert / triggerOnModify must be true (after defaults: insert false, modify true). Hard stop at publish.
rules.message: Choose when the flow runs: on insert, on modify, or both.

rules.check: The configuration dialog refuses to save while no table is picked.
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: Live status line in the configuration dialog (does not block saving): shown when the table does not exist or is not supported.
rules.message: Table %1 does not exist in this environment. | Table %1 is not supported by this trigger, so the flow would never run.

rules.check: guiOnly should be a JSON boolean.
rules.message: (no message; a value that is not a boolean is ignored and the default applies)

rules.check: triggerOnInsert should be a JSON boolean.
rules.message: (no message; a value that is not a boolean is ignored and the default applies)

rules.check: triggerOnModify should be a JSON boolean.
rules.message: (no message; a value that is not a boolean is ignored and the default applies)

rules.check: watchFields[].name should be a valid identifier (^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,29}$) and unique, so that xRec_<name> / Rec_<name> are valid, distinct references. Neither the editor nor publish checks it; the editor only fills an empty name from the field caption.
Any error in the flow (e.g. an Error step) propagates to the user and rolls back the insert/modify together with the flow's own work and execution log.
The flow runs inline in the user's save, so a step that defers the run (Sleep) fails, and the save is rolled back.
rules.message: Step %1 (%2) requested a deferred resume, but the flow is running synchronously. Use Sleep or other time-based deferral steps only outside of synchronous frames (Webhook sync phase or SubFlow body).

notes: Synchronous and atomic: the flow runs in the user's session from the table's before-insert / before-modify event, inside the user's transaction, without any commit. An error prevents the save and rolls everything back, including the execution entry. A Set document field values step writes field values onto the record before it is saved.
Only writes that run table triggers fire the flow (a programmatic Modify(false) / Insert(false) does not). With guiOnly (default) sessions without a user interface are skipped.
Re-entrancy guard: a write that the running flow itself causes on a watched table does not start the flow again.
Watch fields compare the live before-image (xRec) with the after-image using locale-invariant text; this is different from the snapshot used by 'When a record is modified'.
timeoutSec is checked between steps. When it has passed, the remaining steps are skipped and the save continues without a Set document field values answer.

Confirm dialog: Business Central opens no dialog inside the record change, so a Confirm dialog step fails when a user triggers the flow. Publishing warns about it (see the Confirm dialog page). Use a release, post or page trigger to ask the user.
The picker shows 'When a record is created or modified (interactive)'; the enum caption is 'When a document is modified (interactive)'.
No recurring Job Queue entry; the registration is keyed by tableNo.

Picker filter: Set document field values is offered (shared with the other interactive document triggers). Respond to Webhook, Return SubFlow Output, Return PDF, Set report file name and Prevent page close are hidden.
